about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_read.py). bad replays the read-abort class failure of references/target-class.json: it throws the real Tool execution aborted line for the unbounded read. good slices to one small offset window with a limit and a timeout, runs that slice alone, and prints the lines or the receipt it promises.

fixture.notes.md:
# Read notes
slice small windows only.

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: unbounded full read in one call'
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -TotalCount 5 | Out-Null; 'slice limit PASS small window'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: full read of a section that needed a slice'
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath notes.md -TotalCount 2 | Out-Null; 'small check PASS sliced lines'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: reran the whole read after the abort'
pairs.expect: halve slice PASS one window alone
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt | Select-Object -Skip 10 -First 3 | Out-Null; 'halve slice PASS one window alone'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: whole read retried at full width'
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt | Select-Object -Skip 4 -First 2 | Out-Null; 'halved window PASS run alone'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: chained large reads in one session'
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -TotalCount 2 | Out-Null; 'single slice PASS stopped once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: hammered slice retries after the abort'
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -TotalCount 1 | Out-Null; 'once slice PASS stopped abort'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: read with no offset and no limit'
pairs.good: (Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt | Measure-Object -Line).Lines | Out-Null; Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -TotalCount 2 | Out-Null; 'size check PASS sliced small'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: unbounded section read with no size check'
pairs.good: (Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt | Measure-Object -Line).Lines | Out-Null; Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -TotalCount 3 | Out-Null; 'size first PASS sliced window'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: foreground wait on a long read'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Value 'slice 1-5 done'; $t = 0; while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath receipt.txt) -and $t -lt 50) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; $t++ }; Get-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Raw | Out-Null; 'background receipt PASS polled'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: long foreground read with no receipt'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Value 'window 11-13 done'; $t = 0; while ((Get-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Raw).Length -eq 0 -and $t -lt 50) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; $t++ }; 'receipt poll PASS background read'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: silent close with no report'
throw 'Tool execution aborted: repeat abort with no dispatch record'
